class.name: NNBooleanConsideration
class.brief_description: Scores a boolean or threshold input using one of two fixed values.
class.description: A specialized [NNConsideration] for yes/no checks that outputs [member true_score_value] when its input is at least [code]0.5[/code] and [member false_score_value] otherwise. Use this instead of [NNConsideration] with a step curve when you want a simple two-state score from an [NNBooleanSensor] or boolean flag.

method.name: sample_activation_curve
method.description: Returns [member true_score_value] if [param input_value] is at least [code]0.5[/code], or [member false_score_value] otherwise.

members.member: Score returned when the input is below [code]0.5[/code].
Score returned when the input is [code]0.5[/code] or above.
